Sector share: ratio of sums
(not mean of ratios)
note: Reference cumulative LoE of AR 5.76, of AtP 22.91; AR base window central 2016-2025. 'No effect': within 0.01% of the Reference (the economic-allocation rows move AtP only, the AR base window moves AR only). Not shown: α = 1 (Hjalsted et al. SI tables); the raw Stats NZ 2024-base median population (in the data file). Row notes: Carrying capacity: 1 W/m² boundary (not 2 °C): 1 W/m² planetary boundary (Bjørn & Hauschild 2015), safe operating space 3.61 × 10¹² kg CO₂e per year, instead of the 2 °C carrying capacity (Bjørn & Hauschild 2015), 6.81 × 10¹² (the same global impact); both budgets move. Global impact: EF 3.1: global impact (I_glob) from the EF 3.1 normalisation factor (Andreasi Bassi et al. 2023, Table 10; 7.55 × 10³ kg CO₂e per person, 2010) instead of 5.58 × 10¹³ (Bjørn & Hauschild 2015; equal to the EF 3.0 factor, 8.10 × 10³ per person). The 6.7% difference is mainly the lower characterisation factor of methane in EF 3.1. Acquired rights only. AR base window (5–34 yr): mean sector emissions over 5 / 20 / 34 years (2021–2025, 2006–2025, 1992–2025) instead of 10 years (2016–2025); AR only. Economic allocation measure: GDP per capita, current US$: GDP per capita in current US$ instead of GDP per capita at purchasing-power parity, constant 2021 international $ (World Bank WDI); AtP only. Sector share: ratio of sums (not mean of ratios): FCE share of GDP in the sector share: the ratio of the summed FCE to the summed GDP of the 40 quarters 2016–2025 instead of the mean of the 40 quarterly FCE/GDP ratios 2016–2025; AtP only. Population (5th–95th pct.): Stats NZ 2024-base 5th / 95th percentile path instead of the median; carbon and both budgets move together. Population source: UN WPP 2024 median: UN WPP 2024 median for New Zealand instead of the model's population path (the Stats NZ 2024-base median from the observed 2025 level, with the observed 2026 growth); budgets only. Replacement (Low–Very High): as in Extended Data Fig. 8 (carbon only; the budgets are unchanged). Replacement half-life (5–15 yr): as in Extended Data Fig. 8 (carbon only). 2028–2050 only (pipeline years excluded): carbon and both budgets summed over 2028–2050 instead of 2026–2050 (the observed pipeline years excluded); the AR base unchanged. Whole-life accounting (committed at construction): every life-cycle stage, including the emissions committed after 2050, counted in the construction year; the AR base recomputed on the same convention.
